features.name: Document Chunking
features.description: IndexingService splits documents into ~500 char chunks at paragraph boundaries with metadata
features.evidence: IndexingService.chunkDocument() splits on paragraph boundaries, merges paragraphs until ~500 chars, creates Chunk objects with charCount/wordCount metadata. startIndexing() writes chunks/<docId>.json, persists index-meta, and marks the Document status='indexed' with chunk count. Verified: 4 unit tests pass (boundary splitting, chunk count, index-meta persistence, single-chunk case).

features.name: Metadata Extraction
features.description: On import, extract word count, line count, file type, paragraph count, and char count metadata from documents
features.evidence: DocumentService.importDocument() calls extractMetadata() computing wordCount, lineCount, fileType, paragraphCount, charCount from content/filename. Document.metadata populated and persisted; DocumentDetail renders a metadata section. Verified: 3 unit tests pass (counts/filetype, missing-extension default, persistence across reload).

features.name: Indexing Status in StatusBar
features.description: StatusBar shows indexing progress with indexed count, total chunks, and color-coded status indicator
features.evidence: AppStatus extended with indexedCount/totalChunks. app:status IPC registered and exposed via preload. App.tsx polls indexing.status() on import/index/Q&A/refresh. StatusBar renders color-coded dot + indexedCount/documentsLoaded progress + totalChunks. Verified: type-check + build pass.

features.name: Grounded Q&A with Citations
features.description: QaService returns answers with document citations, excerpts, and confidence scores
features.evidence: QaService wired with shared IndexingService (DI in main.ts). ask() retrieves chunks via getAllChunks(), scores by keyword overlap, returns top 2 as citations with documentId/documentTitle/chunkIndex/excerpt. Confidence 0.85 with citations, 0.30 without. App.tsx renders answer + citations + confidence. Verified: 3 unit tests pass (citations present, low-confidence fallback, history persistence).
